title: Burning the Silverfish│燃燒蠹蟲
description: Destroying an infested block with a tool enchanted with Silk Touch will cause it to drop itself. Smelting it in a furnace can restore it to its uninfested state.│使用帶有精準採集附魔的工具破壞蟲蝕方塊會使其掉落自身。將其放入熔爐中熔煉可以使其恢復到沒有被蟲蝕的狀態。
body:
# Function│功能
- Using a Silk Touch-enchanted pickaxe to break an infested block will cause it to drop itself.│使用帶有精準採集附魔的鎬子破壞蟲蝕方塊會使其掉落自身。
- Smelting an infested block in a furnace will turn it back into a normal block.│使用熔爐熔煉蟲蝕方塊可以使其變回一般的方塊。
# Remarks│備註
I recommend you take a look at [this data pack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/rpcrecipe-pack-compatible) to ensure that after installing this data pack, it will not cause incompatibilities with other data packs.│建議您看看[這個資料包](https://modrinth.com/datapack/rpcrecipe-pack-compatible)來確保安裝了此數據包之後不會導致與其他數據包產生不兼容性。
